Game Overview

In Santa Dentist, the core idea is straightforward: brighten smiles in Santa’s workshop as you tackle festive dental challenges. From cleaning cavities to fixing broken teeth, every task brings joy and earns points. Embrace holiday cheer with interactive tools and an array of whimsical patients in this vibrant, family-friendly adventure filled with seasonal fun.
